newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 18.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - President and Nationalist Party Chairman Lee Teng-hui to iron out internal differences on constitutional reforms before Monday's National Development Conference.
Taiwan certain to raise domestic oil prices.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - No provincial government officials to take part in National Development Conference.
Foreign Minister John Chang secretly visits United Arab Emirates, Jordan.
LIBERTY TIMES - New evidence found in murder of women's rights activist Peng Wan-ju's, but taxi driver missing.
Foreign Minister John Chang arrives United Arab Emirates, set to meet members of royal family.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Fair Trade Commission may deny new merger between 7-Eleven chain and other convenience stores.
More than 20 conglomerates interested in bidding for Hsinyi development zone.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Finance ministry to raise pension funds' tax exemption level.
Mobile phone and international telephone fees to be reduced in March.
